description:
About us

 

Hanover is an award-winning communications consultancy that advises enterprises, institutions, and individuals on building recognition and enhancing reputation.

From our offices across Europe and the Middle East, we adopt an integrated approach that connects the dots across channels, audiences and issues.

Our collective of smart, curious people think differently and live by a shared mission, purpose, vision, and values. These shape how we work, not just with our colleagues, but with clients and partners too.

Our mission is to ‘rewire communications for impact’ and harness its transformative power to advocate, trailblaze and make a difference.

We do this by igniting and empowering the potential of every individual within our company, recognising that each person is a unique spark, capable of creating extraordinary impact. We believe that by nurturing and harnessing the collective brilliance of our people, we can drive innovation, foster an uncommon work culture, and make a positive difference to society.

Embracing the complete range of skills and services across the communications spectrum without constraint, we create the best outcomes for our clients and deliver world-class work.

Hanover is actively seeking a highly experienced and dynamic Account Director to become an integral part of our Healthcare Policy, Advocacy & Public Affairs team. This is an exceptional opportunity for someone to leverage their expertise in the healthcare sector and make a significant impact on our client services.

As an Account Director, you will lead client relationships, providing senior strategic counsel and ensuring delivery of high-quality, commercially successful account programmes. You will guide clients through the complex landscape of healthcare policy, advocacy, and public affairs, while leading account teams and overseeing programme delivery and budgets.

You will play a leading role in new business activity, including acquisition, development and pitching, alongside managing and mentoring junior team members.

The role will be based in London and offers the opportunity to work across clients we share with our offices in Brussels, Dublin and the Middle East, as well as integrated accounts with our Healthcare Communications and Digital teams.

The team works across a range of services including government relations, public affairs, market access, policy, advocacy and corporate communications across health and business. With over half of the world’s top 20 pharmaceutical companies, as well as NHS providers, health technology businesses and charities amongst our clients, we offer a diverse and compelling range of issues and opportunities.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead client accounts, ensuring high-quality delivery, strong client satisfaction and commercial performance.
  • Build and lead high-impact political and NHS campaigns to deliver tangible policy change for our clients.
  • Lead high-profile events and stakeholder engagement programmes involving politicians, policymakers, NHS stakeholders and patient groups.
  • Deliver high-quality strategic intelligence and insights to our clients by utilising the Hanover network and building your own network and expertise across policy areas.
  • Maintain an uncompromising commitment to detail, rigorously reviewing all communications, reports and client deliverables to ensure accuracy and professionalism.
  • Identify opportunities to grow existing client relationships and broaden Hanover’s offer across accounts.
  • Develop and implement innovative strategies for growth, staying ahead of industry trends and positioning Hanover as a leader in the field.
  • Take a lead on new business pitches, being a core part of the team in building creative strategies and tactics and pitching to clients.
  • Deliver marketing activity to support Hanover Health’s business growth.
  • Support the management of expert steering groups to drive thought-leadership for our clients.
  • Personal management of junior members of the team providing guidance on professional development.
  • Active participant in championing the mission, vision, purpose, values and behaviours of Hanover.
  • Recognise and value the diverse backgrounds, skills, and perspectives of all individuals at Hanover.

Requirements:

  • Relevant experience from a public affairs consultancy, in-house public affairs department, patient group/NGO, Parliament, or other relevant organisation.
  • Excellent knowledge of health policy and ability to analyse developments within the NHS and commercial environment.
  • A proven track record of success in account management within the healthcare policy, advocacy, or public affairs sector.
  • Eye for detail and ability to think critically about your own work and that of others.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide teams towards achieving shared goals.
  • Strong business acumen with experience in managing budgets and driving business growth.
  • Strong strategic judgement and ability to provide credible counsel to senior clients in complex and fast-moving policy environments.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of building rapport with clients, team members, and stakeholders at all levels.
  • A commitment to professional development, both for self-improvement and for the mentorship of junior colleagues.

 

BENEFITS:

In addition to a competitive salary, your core benefits package will include:

  • Bonus potential linked to recruitment, new business and long service
  • 25 days’ annual leave (plus bank holidays)
  • Private healthcare and dental insurance
  • Travel insurance
  • A company pension plan, including 5% employer contribution

You’ll also have access to a wide range of opportunities and initiatives, including:

  • Flexible working policies, plus eligibility to apply for a sabbatical after 2 years’ service
  • Summer Fridays finish (3pm) – early Friday finish the rest of the year (4pm)
  • The Hanover Academy, which incorporates training, coaching, mentoring and reverse-mentoring opportunities to support personal development and career progression across all levels, with a generous training budget
  • International secondments as well as the opportunity to collaborate with all offices across the AVENIR GLOBAL’s network
  • A wellbeing programme, featuring (but not limited to) pre- and post-maternity leave coaching, a working parents’ group, subsidised gym membership
  • Our Culture Club, with a robust social calendar all year round and CSR activity

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement + 

 

Hanover Communications is an equal opportunities employer, committed to creating and ensuring a fair, inclusive, and diverse work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We believe that equality and diversity are essential to high performance and a thriving culture.

We maintain a strict no-tolerance stance against any form of discrimination and harassment, ensuring all individuals are treated equitably, irrespective of their race, ethnicity, religion, beliefs, age, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, marital or pregnancy status, genetic background, or any other attribute safeguarded under our company policies or federal, state or local laws and legislation.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please send an email to

We are committed to transparency about how we collect and use your data, including ensuring we comply with legal obligations relating to data protection. You can view our data privacy policy here. 

Hanover is part of AVENIR GLOBAL’s powerhouse of specialist communications consultancies across EMEA and North America. Collectively we rank among the top 15 largest communication firms in the world.

description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With 30 offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Über Verve Retail Media

Das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende ist der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis. Marken investieren Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale, können aber nicht belegen, ob daraus Käufe generiert wurden.

Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen Coupons und Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum stationären Kauf gehen: Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.

VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein schnell skalierendes Startup mit einer AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen hinweg. Zudem haben wir Zugriff auf die Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billion ausgelieferter Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr.

Die Rolle in einem Satz

Du gewinnst neue regionale Werbekunden für VRM am Telefon, qualifizierst warme Leads und buchst hochwertige Termine für unsere Account Executives.

Was du tust

  • Telefonische Erstansprache regionaler Werbekunden auf Basis vorqualifizierter Leads
  • Bedarfs- und Entscheiderqualifizierung im Erstgespräch
  • Buchung qualifizierter Termine für die Account Executives im definierten Zielslot
  • Saubere Übergabe inkl. Pain Points, Kontext und Entscheidungsstruktur
  • Strukturierte Vorbereitung jedes Calls — Vorbereitung ist 80 % des Erfolgs

Dein Setup

  • Du arbeitest mit vorqualifizierten Leads — nicht mit Cold-Listen
  • Salesforce als CRM, Aircall für die Telefonie, LLM-gestützte Recherche-Workflows
  • Klares Sales-Playbook mit Pitch-, Einwand- und Übergabe-Logik
  • Regelmäßige 1:1-Coachings, Call-Reviews und Pipeline-Calls

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigene Aktivitäts-Pipeline aufbauen, priorisieren und mit klaren KPIs (Calls/Tag, Termine/Tag, Show-Up-Rate) führen
  • Recherche zu Kunden, Branchen und Standorten als Grundlage jedes Calls
  • Pflege aller Aktivitäten und Opportunities in Salesforce
  • Enge Abstimmung mit den Account Executives: Feedback zur Termin-Qualität, gemeinsame Iteration
  • Aktives Mitwirken an der Weiterentwicklung von Pitches, Skripten und Workflows

So ist die Rolle aufgesetzt

  • Bericht direkt an den Head of Regional Sales
  • Du arbeitest im Team mit anderen SDRs sowie eng mit den Account Executives, an die du übergibst
  • Klare Karriereperspektive: Aufstieg zum Account Executive bei nachgewiesener Performance

Dein Profil

Diese Rolle ist bewusst auf Einsteiger und Quereinsteiger in den Sales zugeschnitten. Du passt, wenn du mindestens eines der folgenden Profile mitbringst:

  • Erste Sales-Erfahrung: Du hast in einer SDR-, BDR-, Inside-Sales-, Outbound-Call-Center- oder Telefonvertriebsrolle gearbeitet und willst auf das nächste Level.
  • Quereinstieg mit Telefonaffinität: Du kommst aus Kundenservice, Retail, Gastronomie, Hotellerie oder einem anderen Umfeld mit viel Kundenkontakt und willst gezielt in den Sales wechseln.

Für beide Profile gilt:

  • Du hast Spaß am Telefon, keine Scheu vor Erstansprache und kannst Menschen schnell für dich gewinnen
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, bereitest dich vor und nimmst KPIs ernst
  • Du bist offen, coachable und willst täglich besser werden
  • Du nutzt LLMs aktiv für Recherche und Vorbereitung, oder bist bereit, das schnell zu lernen
  • Deutsch fließend auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (alle Calls auf Deutsch), Englisch von Vorteil
  • Du willst nicht für immer SDR bleiben, der Aufstieg zum Account Executive ist dein Ziel

Warum diese Rolle

Du steigst nicht in eine fertige Vertriebsmaschine ein. Du baust eine neue Mediagattung im deutschen Markt mit auf — und legst damit die Pipeline-Grundlage für unser komplettes Regional-Sales-Geschäft.

  • Echter Karrierepfad: Bei nachgewiesener Performance Aufstieg zum Account Executive in 12–18 Monaten
  • Warme Leads statt Cold-Calling-Liste
  • KI-gestützte Tools und Workflows, die deine Produktivität vervielfachen
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding und kontinuierliches Coaching
  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: Fixum + transparente Termin-Vergütung + ungedeckelte Commission

Wenn du Sales lernen willst, wo es ernst gemeint ist und wo gute Leistung sichtbar wird, ist das die richtige Rolle.

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success

  • Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work

  • Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives

  • Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack

  • Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases

  • Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams

  • Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building

  • Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager

  • Native German speaker with fluent English proficiency

  • Experience working with enterprise customers, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders

  • Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more

  • Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders

  • Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems

  • Comfortable with python

  • Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science

  • Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

  • A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

  • Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Exposure to modern backend technologies, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, and automated testing. Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance. Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business. Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives. Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission. Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin. An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm. Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes. Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs. Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business. description:
You see software development and team organization not as a rigid set of rules, but as a craft that deserves better tools. You want to design complex, data-rich productivity platforms where information architecture is a first-class problem, and you want to rethink how humans work alongside AI. If you are a designer who values hands-on craft, hates unnecessary bureaucracy, and wants the autonomy to build a team's design process from scratch, this role was built for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 companies rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

YouTrack handles serious complexity – agile boards, backlogs, knowledge bases, helpdesks, and deeply customizable workflows – across teams from two-person startups to global enterprises. We’re at a point where the category's oldest assumptions are worth reconsidering. Issue tracking has relied on the same foundational blocks for years, but AI opens an opportunity to rethink how software can actively help teams get work done.

We need a Lead Product Designer to shape where project management goes next while keeping a massive, mature surface area coherent, legible, and a pleasant to use. In this role, you’ll lead a small design team of two designers, own the overall design quality bar across the product, and act as an individual contributor on our hardest, least-charted problems. You’ll build a fresh design process from scratch with the full backing of a team lead who respects craft and values professional judgment.

Day to day, you will:

  • Shape a point of view on how project management and issue tracking evolve in an AI-native world and turn those concepts into tools people can actually use.
  • Design how people work alongside AI capabilities in YouTrack, from conversational interfaces to inline assistance and background automation.
  • Develop interaction patterns for unsettled problems, including surfacing AI confidence, making actions transparent, and keeping users in control.
  • Prototype and test new concepts quickly, separating ideas that feel clever from those that genuinely reduce friction.
  • Keep a large, deep product coherent so that boards, helpdesks, reports, and administration feel like a single cohesive engine.
  • Partner with product management and engineering to shape roadmap priorities from a design perspective, influencing what gets built and why.

What you’ll bring

  • A deep commitment to craft ownership, holding yourself and your team to high standards without creating bottlenecks.
  • Comfort building clear, lightweight processes, without turning them into restrictive bureaucracy.
  • The generosity to share knowledge openly and collaborate across a broad, global design community.
  • Clarity in your writing and reasoning, with the ability to explain complex design decisions in plain words.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy appetite for finding the right questions before designing the answers.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held, with a clear understanding of when to follow platform conventions and when to break them.

What you’ll need

  • Successfully led the design of complex, data-rich productivity tools or software systems where information architecture is a primary challenge.
  • Proven understanding of how modern AI systems operate beyond single-turn prompts, including agentic workflows and multi-step execution.
  • Experience mentoring and leading other designers, giving clear feedback that lands and raises the bar.
  • Ability to design unified experiences that cater to small startup teams and large enterprise customers simultaneously.
  • A portfolio showing a range of work from precise micro-interactions to large-scale information architecture.

What success looks like

Success means earning the trust of your team and peers through sound interaction choices and clear systemic improvements. You will establish a reliable critique rhythm and a structured way of working that helps your designers grow. Within your first few months, delivering clear patterns for our AI capabilities, paying down accumulated UX debt, and ensuring YouTrack remains both deep and remarkably quick on its feet.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support. Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
  • Free meals and snacks. Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
  • Health and wellness. On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
  • Internal events. Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

description: What is the job? Ready to take the next step in your leadership career and make a real impact within a rapidly growing, patient-focused organisation? We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Team Leader or Manager to join us as a Pharmacy Team Lead. This is an exciting opportunity to bring your leadership experience into a fast-paced healthcare environment, supporting, motivating and developing a high-performing team across both weekday and weekend shifts. You do not need previous pharmacy experience or a pharmacy qualification for this role. What we are looking for is someone with strong people leadership experience who knows how to run a successful shift, manage competing priorities, support their team and maintain high standards in a busy operational environment. As Pharmacy Team Lead, you will be right at the heart of our day-to-day pharmacy operations. This is a hands-on role where no two days will be the same. You will help coordinate shifts, manage changing priorities, resolve operational challenges and provide clear, confident guidance to colleagues. You will act as a visible and approachable point of leadership on shift, ensuring workloads are managed effectively, standards are consistently maintained and any issues are identified and addressed quickly. You will also support the development of your colleagues through regular feedback, coaching and encouragement, helping them build their confidence, strengthen their skills and take pride in the service they provide. Working closely with the Pharmacy Manager and wider Pharmacy Operations team, you will help drive continuous improvement across the pharmacy. Whether it’s finding better ways of working, improving efficiency, strengthening communication or supporting the implementation of new processes, you will have the opportunity to contribute ideas and make a genuine difference to how we operate. This role would be perfect for someone who thrives in a busy environment, enjoys bringing people together and is ready to take greater ownership and responsibility. You will need to be organised, proactive and calm under pressure, with the confidence to make decisions, support colleagues and maintain excellent standards. You don’t need to be a pharmacy expert — you need to be a great leader. We will support you in developing your understanding of our pharmacy environment, processes and requirements. If you are an experienced Team Leader, Supervisor or Manager who is passionate about people, enjoys a fast-paced environment and is excited by the opportunity to build your knowledge within healthcare, we’d love to hear from you. What will you be doing? Providing visible, hands-on leadership to the team during your shifts, helping to create a positive, supportive and collaborative working environment Coordinating daily priorities, allocating tasks and managing workloads to ensure operations run safely, efficiently and smoothly Acting as an approachable first point of contact for colleagues, providing guidance, support and encouragement throughout the working day Monitoring progress against daily priorities and responding quickly to changing demands, operational challenges or staffing requirements Supporting the team to maintain safe, accurate and compliant working practices in line with standard operating procedures, internal policies and regulatory requirements Helping to maintain consistently high standards across day-to-day operational processes Identifying and escalating quality, safety or operational concerns appropriately, ensuring issues are followed through to resolution Working closely with the Pharmacy Manager, Pharmacy Operations and wider teams to resolve queries, improve communication and strengthen ways of working Coaching and developing colleagues through regular feedback, practical support and on-the-job guidance to build their confidence, skills and capability Supporting the onboarding and training of new team members, helping them settle into the team and understand our expected standards Managing performance and addressing day-to-day people challenges in a fair, supportive and constructive way Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen safety and enhance the overall patient experience Supporting the introduction of new processes, systems and operational improvements across the pharmacy Leading by example and creating a culture where people feel supported, accountable and motivated to perform at their best Helping the team deliver a safe, accurate, efficient and exceptional service to every patient What do you need? Previous experience leading, supervising or managing a team in a busy environment Experience managing day-to-day operations, workloads, priorities and staffing requirements Strong people management skills, with the ability to motivate, coach and develop colleagues The confidence to make decisions, resolve challenges and take ownership of issues through to completion Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and keep operations running smoothly during busy periods Excellent attention to detail and a consistent commitment to high standards Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to build positive working relationships across different teams A supportive and approachable leadership style, with a genuine interest in helping others succeed Experience giving feedback and managing performance where required A calm, proactive and solutions-focused approach in a fast-paced and changing environment Confidence using computer-based systems, with the ability to learn new tools and processes quickly Flexibility to work across weekday and weekend shifts as part of the pharmacy rota A willingness to learn and develop your understanding of pharmacy operations, healthcare processes and regulatory requirements A patient-first mindset and a genuine passion for delivering an exceptional standard of service What we’re looking for We are particularly interested in people who have worked as a Team Leader, Assistant Manager, Supervisor, Operations Manager, Store Manager, Contact Centre Team Leader, Warehouse Team Leader or in another people-management position where they have been responsible for leading a team and keeping day-to-day operations running effectively. What matters most is your ability to lead people, manage a busy operation, make good decisions and create a positive, high-performing team environment. Most importantly, you will be someone who is ready to step up, get involved and help create a successful shift for both the team and our patients. What we offer Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + bank holidays Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more Career Growth: Opportunities to develop your leadership skills, collaborate across teams and grow your career within a fast-moving healthcare organisation Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave About Us Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Through our technology, clinical services and specialist pharmacy operations, we support patients throughout their treatment journey, ensuring they receive safe, reliable and high-quality care. As a growing healthcare organisation, we’re building a team of passionate people who want to make a meaningful impact. At Montu UK, your work directly contributes to improving patient experiences and expanding access to modern medical treatments. That partner is you. Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. Five or more years of relationships with family offices, VCs, HNW investors, and institutional allocators, built and kept warm, now put to work for the companies you manage. This is not a fund seat and you will not manage money. You manage raises and the founders running them. Your hours go to judgment, relationships, and the conversations that keep a raise moving. You report directly to the two co-founders and hold the most client-facing seat in the company. What you will own A book of client companies: the weekly rhythm, the momentum, and the relationship, from onboarding through close. Investor meetings end to end for your book: prepared before, debriefed after, feedback captured and delivered honestly. Your own investor relationships, worked for the portfolio: the right company in front of the right allocator at the right moment. Raise readiness across your book: narrative, materials, and data room, kept sharp. Renewals earned through ownership: clients stay because the seat works. description:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

Power Trading & Renewables Analytics Internship Program

Six-Month Internship: 15 February – 12 August 2027
Berlin or Grenoble (full-time, on site)

Engelhart’s Internship Program offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in renewables and power trading analytics. Interns will work closely with front office teams on data-led projects that support commercial decision-making, optimisation, and risk management across energy markets. To be eligible for consideration, applicants must have the right to work in the relevant internship location and be available to commence their six-month internship from 15 February 2027.

The internship opportunities covered by this advert are as follows:

  • Power Analytics Intern, Berlin
  • PPA Optimisation Analytics Intern, Berlin
  • Balancing Risk Management Analytics Intern, Berlin
  • Systematic Quantitative Research Intern, Berlin
  • Renewables Portfolio Analytics Intern, Grenoble

Applicants may indicate areas of particular interest during the process, but final role allocation will be based on business need, candidate profile and overall fit.

We are also hiring for Renewables Origination and Weather Analytics internships in Berlin. These have separate application processes due to their different candidate profiles. Further details are available on our Careers Page.

 What You Can Expect

 Hands-on experience on a dedicated renewables, power or balancing risk management desk, depending on the internship you are hired for, working on projects with real commercial relevance.

  • Exposure to how data, analytics and optimisation support trading, portfolio management or risk management decisions in energy markets, depending on desk requirements.
  • Close learning and mentorship from experienced front office professionals, including direct exposure to desk leadership.
  • A structured six-month internship within a global commodities business, combining cohort-based learning with deep desk integration.

Example Project Areas

Depending on the internship opportunity, projects may include working with large trading, market or asset-related datasets, supporting optimisation work linked to renewable assets, PPAs, BESS, balancing risk management or systematic trading strategies, and developing Python-based analytical tools, predictive models, dashboards or workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with a front office team on data-led projects within renewables, power or balancing risk management, depending on the internship role.
  • Analyse large market, trading or asset-related datasets to identify insights that support commercial decision-making, portfolio management, systematic trading strategies and, where relevant, automated trading execution.
  • Develop, test or improve analytical tools, models, dashboards or workflows using Python and other relevant tools.
  • Support optimisation under uncertainty, forecasting, predictive modelling, simulation, reporting or risk management activities, depending on desk requirements.
  • Conduct market research and present findings clearly to technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Contribute to day-to-day desk activity, building practical understanding of how analytics supports trading and portfolio decisions.

About You

Across our 2027 internship program, we are looking for motivated, intellectually curious individuals who are keen to apply strong analytical and technical skills to real business challenges in power and renewables markets. You should be comfortable working with data, learning quickly, and collaborating closely with front office teams in a fast-paced trading environment.

The following experiences and skills are essential for application:

  • Strong academic background in a quantitative discipline such as Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Quantitative Economics, Finance, Energy Economics or a related STEM field.
  • Strong Python skills, with the ability to analyse, manipulate and interpret complex data sets.
  • Strong grounding in statistics, econometrics, machine learning, predictive modelling or optimisation, with the ability to apply quantitative methods to practical trading, market or risk problems.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach.
  • Evidence of applying data analysis, coding or quantitative methods to a practical problem, gained through academic projects, internships, research, personal projects or other relevant experience.
  • Demonstrable interest in energy markets, including an ability to discuss relevant industry developments in power, renewables, risk management or commodities trading, gained through academic study, projects, internships, research, or personal interest.
  • Business-level English proficiency.
  • Right to work in Germany and/or Switzerland for the full duration of the internship.
  • Effective communication skills and a collaborative mindset, with the confidence to work closely with commercial and technical stakeholders.
  • Intellectual curiosity, with the motivation to understand how market fundamentals, data and commercial decisions interact.

The following would be advantageous:

  • Experience with SQL, data visualisation, advanced modelling techniques or applying machine learning / AI to market, trading or quantitative research problems.
  • Exposure to optimisation, forecasting, time-series analysis, quantitative finance, algorithmic trading concepts or large trade/market datasets.

We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.

description: Wofür wir stehen: “We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.” Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit. Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact. Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. Deine Aufgaben: Deine Mission: Suche verändert sich gerade schneller als jedes Lehrbuch mitschreiben kann. Unsere Kunden – B2B-Marktführer aus Maschinenbau, Industrie und Handel – werden nicht mehr nur bei Google gefunden, sondern auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode. Wie man das systematisch messbar macht, ist eine offene Frage. Wir bauen dafür gerade eine Methodik auf, und du bist dabei nicht die Person, die Folien formatiert, sondern die, die die Daten liefert, auf denen die Methodik steht. AI-Sichtbarkeit messen: Du führst unsere definierten Prompt-Sets regelmäßig über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode aus, dokumentierst, welche Marken und Quellen zitiert werden, und erkennst Veränderungen über die Zeit. Das ist die Datengrundlage, aus der unsere GEO-Methodik entsteht. SEO-Daten aufbereiten: Crawls mit Screaming Frog, Exporte aus der Search Console, Ranking- und Wettbewerbsvergleiche. Du bringst Rohdaten in eine Form, mit der man arbeiten kann – und fällst auf, wenn dir dabei etwas Merkwürdiges auffällt. Logfiles auswerten: Du prüfst, ob und wie AI-Crawler wie GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot oder PerplexityBot auf Kundenseiten zugreifen – und ob sie vielleicht geblockt werden, ohne dass es jemand gemerkt hat. Tracking testen: Du prüfst nach, ob Tracking-Setups wirklich das tun, was sie sollen: Events feuern, Consent-Zustände greifen, Zahlen plausibel. Du lernst dabei GA4 und Google Tag Manager von der Seite kennen, die man in keinem Kurs sieht. Reportings vorbereiten: Du baust die Datenbasis für monatliche Kunden-Reportings auf und lernst, welche Zahl eine Entscheidung stützt und welche nur den Report füllt. Methodik dokumentieren: Du hältst fest, wie wir vorgehen – Prompt-Sets, Definitionen, Grenzen der Messung. Am Ende deines Praktikums existiert etwas, das ohne dich weiterläuft. Das ist der Teil, auf den du später im Bewerbungsgespräch zeigen kannst. Mitdenken erlaubt, ausdrücklich: Du sitzt in Team-Terminen dabei, hörst mit, wenn Ergebnisse diskutiert werden, und darfst fragen, warum wir etwas so machen. Manchmal ist die ehrliche Antwort „weil wir es immer so gemacht haben“ – und dann ist deine Frage die beste des Tages. description:
About Behavox:

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world. 

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise. 

Our approach is unique, and it’s validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before. 

 

About the Role:

As we scale, Behavox is looking for a hands-on Senior HR Business Partner. In this role, you will help to drive people programs that fuel high performance, agility and collaboration across the business.  This is an exciting opportunity for someone who  thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and is passionate about elevating company performance and building scalable people practices. 

Reporting to the Head of HR,  you’ll bring deep HR expertise and business acumen to help leaders navigate complex challenges and drive business growth. This role requires a strong ability to influence, advise, and partner cross-functionally. 

The success of this role will be measured by its ability to:

  1. Serve as the London office site leader, regional HR Business Partner for the UK, and work with leadership across all functions to execute and align talent strategies with business priorities. 
  2. Support organizational design, team scaling and workforce planning as the business evolves rapidly.
  3. Provide expert counsel on complex employee matters. 
  4. Drive execution of people initiatives in the UK, ensuring alignment with global frameworks and localization for compliance, culture relevance and effectiveness. 

What You'll Bring:

  • A deep and genuine interest in Behavox as demonstrated by a connection to its mission, market and/or technologies.
  • 10+ years progressive HR experience, preferably in high-growth tech environments (AI, SaaS or deep tech.)
  • Deep business acumen and a track record of supporting organizations through rapid growth and change. 
  • In-depth knowledge of UK employment law and regulatory frameworks.
  • Excellent judgement and experience managing complex, nuanced employee matters.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, manage ambiguity, and deliver results under tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills across diverse functions and geographies.

What You'll Do:

  • Proactively mitigate risks and ensure compliance through sound employee relations practices.
  • Independently lead large-scale initiatives with minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Build stage appropriate HR programs and processes in a fast-paced environment.
  • Manage performance management, career development, and training programs that support employee growth and engagement.
  • Leverage people metrics and analytics to guide decisions, identify trends and drive continuous improvement.
  • Partner closely with the HRBP for North America and with COEs (e.g. Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, HR Ops) to deliver a unified and seamless employee experience.

 

What We Offer

  • A truly global mission with a passionate highly talented community in locations all over the World
  • The ability to have significant impact and potential for learning as our aspirations require bold innovation
  • A highly competitive cash compensation package with performance bonuses baked into salary payments
  • A flexible work schedule that allows for Remote or Hybrid work as appropriate to the role and location
  • A very generous time-off policy (30 days annually), with public holidays for your geography in addition

 

About Our Process

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment. 

During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.

The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible. Please note, all Zoom interviews will be recorded.

description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

You’ll lead product launches to help amplify Vanta’s presence in the region, and partner closely with our product management team to identify growth opportunities for us to continue building our product. Finally, you’ll partner closely with our GTM organisation to expand Vanta’s footprint and accelerate our growth. What you’ll do as a Product Marketing Lead at Vanta: Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s business in EMEA tailored to the unique opportunities across the EMEA region Develop tailored messaging and positioning for EMEA based on market research and customer insights Partner with our EMEA growth team on the development and execution of targeted marketing campaigns, including tailored messaging and content that effectively engage local audiences and drive business objectives Plan and execute large product launches (including GTM enablement of sales and customer success), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale Author compelling content for each stage of the customer journey, from blog posts to sales collateral Talk regularly to Vanta’s customers, analyze your own data, and understand our competitive landscape to help shape the product strategy and roadmap and inform Vanta’s overall EMEA marketing strategy Partner closely with the EMEA team at Vanta – including demand gen, sales, customer success, and product—to help achieve our objectives in the market Refine Vanta’s pricing and packaging based on deep insights around the market, our product value, and customer needs in partnership with finance, operations, product, sales, and customer success Be a strong customer champion, creative marketer, and problem solver How to be successful in this role: Have 7+ years of Product Marketing experience, with an emphasis on B2B SaaS Have a deep empathy for users and an ability to adapt communication to best reach, engage and differentiate Vanta to your audience Enjoy working with data and pairing those quantitative conclusions with the qualitative conversations you have with users Find delight in understanding how things work and then explaining your newfound knowledge to others Must be based on London or Dublin, this role will be hybrid in-office Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. description: Intro Adsquare's mission is centered on: Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data. Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers. Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them: Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes. Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves. Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy. Your Mission As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted. Your Profile 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem. Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams. Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog. Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation. Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering. A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic. A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs. A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly. What you will do Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories. Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads. Manage internal dependencies — SLAs, schema contracts, and joint roadmap touchpoints — with downstream squads such as Measurement, Activation, and Data Products. Coordinate releases of new schemas, ingestion endpoints, match logic changes, and signal product enhancements. Act as the primary PO-level counterpart to data supplier and panel partner technical teams, co-owning ingestion specs and schema contracts. Support the Lead PM on new supplier partnerships and panel expansion through feasibility input, integration scoping, and prototype delivery. Define, own, and report on operational KPIs such as signal freshness, SLA adherence, panel coverage, schema validation pass rate, and match rate. Establish SLIs, SLOs, and escalation paths in partnership with engineering, and own the operational visibility layer (dashboards, alerts) that surfaces data product health. Nice to Have Based in Berlin, or open to working from our Berlin office periodically. Prior experience collaborating directly with identity vendors, panel providers, or purchase-data suppliers on schema and integration work. We care about your mental health and provide coaching and counseling sessions through our collaboration with the Fürstenberg Institut. We equip you with the latest hardware and all the tools you need to thrive. What success looks like

Success in this role means you're independently driving improvements in the RustRover debugger, bridging the gap between the C++ backend and the Kotlin/Java client. You are actively solving complex configuration issues, introducing reliable new features, and leaving the codebase cleaner than you found it. Ultimately, you are earning the trust of the Rust community by making their debugging experience significantly smoother.

description:
Type: Full-time, salaried employment
Location: Remote, United Kingdom only.
Salary Range:  £90,000 - £105,000 + stock options.

Who We Are

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.

We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Senior Product Manager, you will take ownership of how data is processed at Focal, and shape what that path becomes: from the imports that bring a retailer's planograms, inventory and store metadata into our platform, through the pipelines that turn them into signal, to the metrics and reports their head office acts on. You will work with data engineering, data scientists, analytics, customer success and the retailers themselves. What you build are data products, and the measure of one is what a retailer does differently because of it.

This is a hands-on role. You will set direction and priorities as we roll out to hundreds of new stores, but you are also expected to know the systems well enough to be a partner in an engineering design conversation, pull your own numbers when something looks wrong, and hold a strong position in the discussions with customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • You are a peer to the engineers you work with, someone who understands the systems well enough to know what is expensive and why and when to push back
  • You are drawn to the seams between teams, where ownership is shared and the hardest problems live
  • You write your own queries and interrogate the answers before anyone else has to, and you can name the business number a data product of yours moved
  • You can change your mind in a technical argument, and you can point to the time you did
  • You have strong judgment about what not to build, and you have killed your own work when it stopped earning its place
  • You use AI as part of how you actually work, and you have built things with it that other people went on to use, not demos you gave once
  • You communicate complicated things crisply to people who do not share your context, including customers hearing an answer they did not want
  • You build things that outlast you, whether runbooks, tooling or documented decisions, because you would rather remove yourself as a dependency than be indispensable

What You Will Do

  • Own product direction for the full data path, from how a retailer's data arrives to what our reports say, and set the priorities where the two ends pull against each other
  • Own how customer data gets into Focal: imports, planograms, store metadata, cut-off configuration, and the chain-specific flows each retailer needs
  • Own what comes out and whether anyone acts on it: the metrics, the reporting APIs, the insight-generating agents, and the customer-facing dashboards a head office runs its week on
  • Run discovery with retailers and store colleagues, and turn what you learn into a product
  • Ship, then find out whether anyone used it, and act on the answer
  • Automate your own work with AI and share what you build with the rest of the product team

What You Need to Be Successful

  • 5+ years in product management, including real time on a technically deep product where you owned integrations, data, or both
  • Enough technical depth to reason about APIs, data pipelines and system boundaries, and to be an equal partner in an engineering discussion
  • Experience building for a hierarchy of users who need different things from the same data: a store manager, a regional director and a head of supply chain reading one dataset three ways, served by one configurable surface
  • Hands-on comfort with SQL and the ability to answer your own data questions
  • Fluency in the analytics and BI tooling landscape, and a view on what makes a dashboard worth returning to rather than merely correct
  • Demonstrated ownership of a product roadmap end to end, from problem definition through to something shipped and adopted
  • A track record of getting things done across teams, and the communication to influence engineering and commercial partners
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers, including holding a position they disagree with
  • Comfortable operating remote-first, across a distributed team
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for store and customer visits

What Would Set You Apart

  • Experience in working with high-volume, noisy sensor or computer-vision data
  • Experience with change data capture into a cloud warehouse (ideally Snowflake)
  • Experience shipping AI-powered features, including the call on when a model is good enough to ship

Why Focal Systems

Joining Focal Systems means becoming part of a company that's truly making a difference in the retail world. Here's why you should consider us:

  • Strong Values and Mission: We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.
  • Exceptional Team: We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.
  • Outstanding Partners: We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavours.

What we offer

We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:    

  • Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock
  • Generous Paid Time Off 
  • Pension
  • Sick Leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Learning and Development Budget

description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here. What we're looking for We're looking for someone hungry to learn and early in their career to join us as our Revenue Operations Associate! You'll get an inside look at, and be a key part of, how a high-performing GTM function operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth business moving. You'll sit at the intersection of our GTM, Customer and Finance teams, keeping our systems, data, and reporting sharp as we scale. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role – you'll inherit processes that are still being built, and you'll have real room to audit what's working, fix what isn't, and put your own stamp on how we operate. You'll get broad exposure early: one week you might be untangling a HubSpot workflow, the next you're building a dashboard the CCO takes into a board meeting. It's a genuinely excellent grounding in how a B2B SaaS business scales – but it comes with real pace, longer hours than a typical first job, and a learning curve to match. If you want breadth of exposure and a steep climb early in your career, this is a great seat. What Can You Expect? Keep our GTM tech stack in good shape: Own day-to-day CRM administration – data hygiene, permissions, and workflow upkeep – and support the configuration and integration of the wider stack. Stay ahead of what's new: Keep across releases and new features across our tools – joining release webinars, reading release notes, and flagging what's worth adopting. Help evaluate and set up new tools: Get involved as we add to the stack, from evaluation through to implementation. Improve our data quality: Spot where data is incomplete or inconsistent, fix what you can, and propose fixes for the rest. Build reporting and dashboards: Turn raw data into dashboards and reports that track pipeline health, funnel conversion, and the other KPIs the GTM team relies on day to day. Support incentive tracking: Help maintain and monitor commission and incentive tracking, making sure calculations are accurate. Onboard new GTM joiners: Train new starters across the GTM and Customer teams on our tools and processes so they're productive quickly. Own our recurring admin cadence: Take ownership of the regular tasks that keep the engine running and look to automate where ever possible. About You You have a top-class academic record: you'll have graduated with (or be on track for) a 1st class degree, or have attended one of the top universities in the country you studied in – we're looking for a strong, proven track record of academic performance as the clearest early signal of the analytical rigour this role needs. You're curious about how technology fits together: you likely have a STEM background, and you enjoy working out how systems, data, and workflows connect to make a business run – even if you've never worked in RevOps before. You want pace, eyes open: you're drawn to a fast-scaling business precisely because of the pace, and you understand that means longer hours and a steeper learning curve than a typical grad role. You see that as a trade worth making. You're happy to get stuck in: you know not every task here is glamorous – some of it is spreadsheet clean-up, data hygiene, or repetitive admin – and you take real satisfaction in doing that work well, not just the exciting parts. You want to understand how B2B SaaS businesses scale: you're looking to build a first-hand understanding of the GTM engine – pipeline, systems, data, and the commercial mechanics behind it – as a foundation for wherever your career goes next. At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out. A few things to note: We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here. We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here! We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background). We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow! description: Revenue Operations – Working Student Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Unsere Mission für dich Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln. trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen. Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen. Das Team Unser Revenue-Operations-Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Es verbindet verschiedene Teams miteinander, schafft effiziente Prozesse und befähigt unseren Vertrieb, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Dadurch entsteht ein dynamisches Umfeld, das nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglicht. Deine Aufgaben Angebotserstellung (Configure-Price-Quote): Du erstellst auf Basis von Kundendaten maßgeschneiderte Angebote und Energiekonzepte – von passgenauen Stromversorgungsangeboten bis hin zu Batteriespeicherlösungen für die Industrie Deal-Analyse und Pricing: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives und der Vertriebsleitung zusammen, um Deals ganzheitlich zu bewerten - dabei erkennst du Ausnahmen und Besonderheiten, weist auf sie hin und koordinierst die notwendigen Freigaben mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern. CRM & Deal-Management: Du verantwortest das Deal-Management in unserem CRM – einschließlich der Zuordnung von Deals in Deal-Phasen, der korrekten Erfassung von Produktkategorien und Umsätzen Nach wem wir suchen Du denkst analytisch und arbeitest gerne mit Daten. Auffälligkeiten entgehen dir nicht – du gehst ihnen systematisch auf den Grund und identifizierst ihre Ursachen. Du gehst Probleme strukturiert und mit Neugier an. Auch bei einer zunächst unklaren Fragestellung findest du immer eine gute Lösung. Du kommunizierst schriftlich klar und präzise und arbeitest gerne mit internen Stakeholdern sowie Kund:innen und Vertriebspartnern zusammen. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Auge für Details. Ob ein fehlendes Datum oder eine uneinheitliche Definition einer Kennzahl – du erkennst solche Unstimmigkeiten bevor sie zum Problem werden. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System wie HubSpot oder Salesforce ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist, dass du bereit bist, dich schnell und gründlich in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten. Deine ersten 6 Wochen: Du hast ein fundiertes Verständnis zu unserem Geschäftsmodell, unserem Produkt und den energiewirtschaftlichen Kontext aufgebaut. Du hast unser CRM-, CPQ- und Reporting-Setup vollständig kennengelernt und kannst dich selbstständig in Deal-Daten und Pipeline-Ansichten orientieren. Du steuerst unsere Deal-Desk-Prozesse selbstständig. Du hast dich als verlässliche Ansprechperson im Unternehmen bei Fragen rund um Deals und die Angebotsprozesse etabliert. Warum wir? Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt. Die Position: Bereits ab der ersten Woche verantwortest du ein Format für unsere Kund:innen – von der Recherche über den Entwurf bis zur Veröffentlichung. Gleichzeitig schreibst du Inhalte für Suchmaschinen und siehst direkt, welche Wirkung deine Texte erzielen. Verantwortung und Unterstützung: Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung für dein eigenes Format und arbeitest dabei mit einem erfahrenen Team zusammen, das deine Arbeit sorgfältig prüft und dir konkretes Feedback gibt, wie du sie weiter verbessern kannst. Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung. Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt – einschließlich einer realistischen Möglichkeit, nach deinem Studium dauerhaft bei uns einzusteigen. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können. Vergütung und Benefits: Dich erwarten eine attraktive Vergütung, Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents. Wenn du strategisch denkst, operativ stark bist und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft. Über uns Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen.
